baseline_note: PR #238 head (main e153f86 plus the test-name fix). No search on these packs ran before this file.
scope: 20 new questions on five repositories that no earlier trial used: vapor, protobuf, spring-boot, mojo and elixir. The packs pin the HEAD commit of each cached local clone; the include lists keep one source area and its tests.

selection.method: Eligible files match the pack's test folder prefix and file-name pattern, count as tests under is_test_path, are not runner, helper, fixture, support, mock or stub files, and contain a test case marker of the language (Swift func test.../@Test, C++ TEST/TEST_F/TEST_P, Java @Test, Perl ok/is/like at line start or ->..._ok, Elixir test "..."). Sort, shuffle with random.Random(seed + pack), and take the first three from distinct parent folders. If a pack has fewer than three such folders, take the next files in shuffle order.
templates: Where is the test for X?
selection.replacement_rule: If a drafter finds no implementation for a drawn file inside the pack, the next file in the shuffle order that is not chosen, not rejected, and not in a parent folder of the other two chosen files replaces it, and the record keeps the reason.

queries.query: Which tests cover adjusting the per-request log verbosity to trace level inside a route handler?

evidence.relevance: The route handler raises its own request logger to trace level and the test checks that the request still succeeds.
The request logger setter stores the changed logger, so the new log level applies to this request.

queries.template: Where is the test for X?
queries.query: Where is the test for the failure message naming a missing snake-case JSON key and its path?

evidence.relevance: The test decodes JSON without the snake-case key is_free and checks the exact error reason text.
This case builds the 'No such key ... at path ...' reason for a missing key decoding failure.

queries.query: Find the tests for asynchronously constructing an app that keeps a caller-supplied log label

evidence.relevance: The test creates the application asynchronously with a custom logger and checks that its label is kept.

evidence.quote: Application(environment, eventLoopGroupProvider, async: true, logger: logger)
evidence.relevance: The async factory passes the caller-supplied logger into the application initializer.

queries.query: Where is URLEncodedFormParser defined and where is it called?

evidence.relevance: Definition of the URL-encoded form parser type.
The URL-encoded form decoder creates its parser instance here.

queries.query: Which tests cover RBS signature generation when a proto sets an explicit Ruby package with module separators?

evidence.relevance: The explicit-package golden test runs the RBS generator on a proto whose ruby_package is "A::B::C" and compares the output.
When the explicit Ruby package already contains "::", the RBS module path is used as-is instead of being converted from dotted package parts.

queries.template: Where is the test for X?
queries.query: Where is the test for stripping hash comments when parsing a simple line-oriented input stream?

evidence.relevance: The comment-dropping test case expects text after '#' on a line to be removed before the line is consumed.
The line parser finds the first '#' and truncates the line there, which drops the comment.

queries.query: Find the tests for writing and reading back length-prefixed messages and detecting a clean end of stream

evidence.relevance: After both delimited messages are read back, a further read must fail and report a clean end of stream.
When the size varint cannot be read, clean EOF is reported only if no bytes were consumed.

queries.query: Where is PackageToModule defined and where is it called?

evidence.relevance: Definition of the helper that converts a snake_case package part into a PascalCase Ruby module name.
The RBS generator calls it to build the module path for each dotted package part.

queries.query: Which tests cover joining array elements into a string using a custom separator annotation on the field?

evidence.relevance: The test checks that an array field annotated with a dash separator is joined as 1-2-3.
The array converter delegates here, where the separator comes from the field annotation or defaults to a comma.

queries.template: Where is the test for X?
queries.query: Where is the test for combining several comma-separated styling options into one ANSI escape sequence for log output?

evidence.relevance: The test gives one comma-separated option and expects a single combined bold and red escape sequence.
The logback converter splits each option on commas and collects every matching ANSI element.

queries.query: Find the tests for skipping a missing config location marked optional while still loading the remaining property files

evidence.relevance: The test adds a nonexistent optional location and checks that the other files still load.
The importer ignores a not-found error when the location or resource is optional.

queries.query: Where is AnsiOutput defined and where is it called?

evidence.relevance: Definition of the class.
The logback color converter calls the class to build ANSI output.

queries.query: Which tests cover per-object methods added at runtime staying hidden when asking whether the class supports them?

evidence.relevance: Asserts that a method registered for one object is not reported by the class's can lookup.
The patched can returns undef when the found code is the generated dynamic dispatcher, which hides the method.

queries.template: Where is the test for X?
queries.query: Where is the test for a client request aborting with an error once its overall time limit expires?

evidence.relevance: Checks that a request to a never-finishing route fails with the overall request time limit error.
The user agent starts a timer for the configured request time limit and sets the error when it fires.

queries.query: Find the tests for running a fallback callback only when the previous assertion in a chain failed

evidence.relevance: Asserts that only the callback after the failed assertion ran, not the one after the passing assertion.
Test::Mojo invokes the callback only when the last test result was not successful.

queries.query: Where is proxy_connect defined and where is it called?

evidence.relevance: Definition of proxy_connect, which builds a CONNECT transaction for proxied HTTPS or WebSocket requests.
The user agent calls proxy_connect when it sets up a connection through a proxy.

queries.query: Which tests cover raising an error when a deprecation annotation receives a number instead of a reason string?

evidence.quote: assert_raise ArgumentError, ~r"should be a string with the reason"
evidence.relevance: The test sets @deprecated to 1.2 and asserts an ArgumentError that asks for a reason string.

evidence.quote: defp preprocess_attribute(:deprecated, value) when not is_binary(value)
evidence.relevance: This clause rejects a non-binary @deprecated value and raises the ArgumentError that the test checks.

queries.template: Where is the test for X?
queries.query: Where is the test for the deprecated grouping function treating a nil leftover as dropping the incomplete final group?

evidence.relevance: The test asserts that the deprecated four-argument chunk call with a nil leftover gives the same result as the :discard mode.
The deprecated chunk/4 replaces a nil leftover with :discard before it delegates to chunk_every/4.

queries.query: Find the tests for building call frames from a compile context lacking a current function or module

evidence.relevance: The stacktrace test expects a :__MODULE__/0 frame when the environment has no current function.
Macro.Env.stacktrace/1 builds the :__MODULE__/0 frame in the branch for an environment without a function.

queries.query: Where is defdelegate_all defined and where is it called?

evidence.relevance: Definition of Kernel.Utils.defdelegate_all/3.
The defdelegate/2 macro in Kernel calls defdelegate_all/3 to get the delegation target.
